title: Conditions of Contract on the Standby Charge for a Paused Workplace Cafe Management Program Site
content:
## Clause 1 the charge on a paused site
A cafe contract on which counter service has been paused carries a standby charge for the pause. The charge is raised on the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract held for the site.

## Clause 2 the suspended days counted
The suspended days counted are the suspended calendar days standing against the current contract year.

## Clause 3 the months of pause charged
The suspended days counted are divided by thirty and rounded down to a whole month with a minimum of one to give the months of pause charged.

## Clause 4 the standby rate and the standby fee base
The standby rate is the standby percentage printed against the service model. The standby fee base is the monthly management fee printed against the service model.

## Clause 5 the late resumption loading
The late resumption loading is the nil late resumption loading, being 0 per cent.

## Clause 6 how the charge is assembled
The standby charge is the standby fee base taken at the standby rate, rounded to the nearest cent, charged for each month of pause charged, and the late resumption loading is then applied once to the figure that step leaves, adding to that figure the late resumption loading taken of it; the result is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Clause 7 the period the charge belongs to
The standby charge is recorded against the billing period in which it is raised.

## Clause 8 a figure worked on hypothetical inputs
Take a hypothetical monthly management fee printed against the service model of 3612.45 USD, a hypothetical standby percentage printed against the service model of 28 per cent, and 97 suspended calendar days standing against the current contract year. The suspended days counted are 97; divided by thirty and rounded down to a whole month, with the minimum of one not biting, the months of pause charged are 3. The standby fee base of 3612.45 USD taken at 28 per cent is 1011.486 USD, which rounded to the nearest cent is 1011.49 USD; charged for each of the 3 months of pause charged, that comes to 3034.47 USD. The late resumption loading of 0 per cent applied once to the figure that step leaves gives 3034.47 USD, and the result rounded to the nearest cent is 3034.47 USD, recorded against the billing period in which the charge is raised.
